Yours
Nicola from Chaosmonger Studio

notes.title: ENCODYA Neon Edition Released Today for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that in cooperation with [i][b]Meridiem Games[/b][/i] that a special boxed [b]Neon Edition[/b] of our dystopian point-and-click adventure game [b]ENCODYA[/b] is now available for [b]Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4[/b] across European specialist retailers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/993e7de23ae52df8d378666f0cd3f64702660694.png[/img]

[h3]About ENCODYA[/h3]
ENCODYA transports players to the dystopian near-future of Neo-Berlin, where a young orphan girl named Tina teams up with a hulking mass of metal and wiring named SAM-53 to bring light and happiness back to the hellish cyberpunk landscape of 2062. 

[h3]About the ENCODYA Neon Edition[/h3]
[b]Meridiem Games[/b] is responsible for the design, manufacturing, and European distribution of the boxed [b]ENCODYA - NEON Edition[/b] and has created a beautiful box containing carefully curated themed extras. Inside the specially designed box with exclusive artwork, point-and-click adventure fans will receive a set of postcards depicting some of the stunning art from the game as well as a cut-to-shape cardboard figure of the protagonist Tina and her robot guardian Sam-53.

notes.title: ENCODYA Now Available For iOS And Android Mobile Devices
notes.notes:
[i]In the grim setting of Neo Berlin, 2062, denizens of the collapsing city cling to what little faith they have. In a world consumed by turmoil and greed, an unlikely savior emerges.[/i]

Today, together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i] we are happy to announce the iOS and Android mobile release of ENCODYA, the award-winning cyberpunk point-and-click adventure. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6811fe7fbf132fd6abc83f7c2e2d9229333f6b9c.png[/img][/url]

First launched for PC on Steam and GOG, the bittersweet tale follows the journey of the protagonist Tina, an orphaned nine-year-old who suddenly has the fate of the world on her shoulders. Together with her guardian, a hulking yet fiercely protective robot called SAM-53, the wholesome duo must finish the mission her father started: freeing the lifeless Megapolis from the clutches of the soulless corporations controlling it. 

[h3]Watch the all-new mobile launch trailer for ENCODYA: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=EvTBzzwbHoM;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EvTBzzwbHoM[/previewyoutube]


[h3]Features of ENCODYA:[/h3]
Tina and SAM-53’s journey takes them across various realities full of bizarre robotic creatures and grotesque, corrupt human beings. Through delightful puzzles and exciting dialogue, they’ll uncover the conspiracies hiding in plain sight. ENCODYA captures the magic and wonder of Studio Ghibli while embracing a Blade Runner-esque atmosphere and environment. Discover what it means to fight for a life worth living in this bittersweet, dystopian adventure.

[list][*] Explore the dark cyberpunk world of ENCODYA in 2.5D with two loveable, playable characters — Tina and SAM-53
[*] [b]Over 34 eccentric NPCs[/b] bring the world of ENCODYA to life and provide a varied and exciting story [b]across 100 unique locations[/b] where there are endless places to discover
[*] The original soundtrack, specially created for ENCODYA, and professional voice actors make the exciting, crackling atmosphere even more tangible.[/list]


[h3]Additional information[/h3]
[b]ENCODYA is also available on PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/7ccaf501a94461f8e19184c4bae72ba97e74a311.jpg[/img][/url]
The PC version on Steam can be purchased with [b]Assemble Entertainment’s Save the World Edition[/b], which includes the game’s art book, soundtrack, exclusive wallpapers, and a collection of developer diaries. The special edition supports Plan International, a charity committed to advancing children's rights and equality for young girls.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/

notes.title: ENCODYA is Now Available on Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4
notes.notes:
It’s time to turn a dystopia into a thriving utopia in our cyberpunk-inspired point-and-click adventure ENCODYA — now available for digital download on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/fb7aba80d2588a026a65ac18ccbdbab8cabc8c64.gif[/img][/url]

Developed by [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i], ENCODYA follows the story of an orphan girl in Neo-Berlin left to the “wolves,” aka, a merciless, angry, and miserable society held under the clutches of tyrannical corporations in a grimly futuristic 2062. 
All hope is not lost, however, as little nine-year-old Tina has the company of a massive mechanical brute: a robotic friend called SAM-53. 
Together, the two must undertake a critical mission to save the world as they know it. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6787498da326c8484042133ddea429397402c69c.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Watch the ENCODYA console release Trailer on YouTube here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=hBCaqtbh0dQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Tina and SAM-53’s adventures take them across different realities full of bizarre robotic creatures and grotesque human beings. Through puzzles and exciting dialogue, they’ll find out the true meaning of being alive. ENCODYA captures the sweetness and wonder of Studio Ghibli while embracing a Blade Runner-esque atmosphere and environment. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/f962da986848a9276d5019330454e0cd1ba36b7d.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Features of ENCODYA Include: [/h3]
[list][*] Explore the dark cyberpunk world of ENCODYA in 2.5D with two playable characters — Tina and SAM-53
[*] Over 34 non-player characters bring the world of ENCODYA to life and provide a varied and exciting story
[*] Your journey will take you to more than 100 locations where there are endless places to discover and explore
[*] Special, randomly generated puzzles provide a unique gaming experience and present you with great challenges
[*] The cinematic cutscenes and the futuristic art and sound design bring the story of ENCODYA alive
[*] The original soundtrack, specially created for ENCODYA, makes the exciting, crackling atmosphere even more tangible

As [i][b]Chaosmonger Studios’[/b][/i] debut title, ENCODYA launched on PC via Steam earlier this year to overwhelming critical acclaim. A few positive reviews include: 
[list][*] [i]“If you like point-and-click adventure games, you should play ENCODYA, it's as simple as that. The story is fulfilling, the soundtrack is to die for, and there is a whole fun world to dive into. 4/5”[/i] – ImpulseGamer

[*] [i]"Pixar does cyberpunk...If you’re a lover of classic adventure games, ENCODYA is worthy of your time. 74/100”[/i] — Fullsync[/list]

[b]ENCODYA is now available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.[/b]

notes.title: Third ENCODYA Developer Featurette has been released!
notes.notes:
[i][b]There are plenty of parallels to draw between creating a film and creating a video game, but the interactive nature of the latter is a whole different ball game that brings with its unique challenges. [/b][/i]

Today, together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i], we are offering a peek into the mind of a man who has filled both roles: [i][b]Nicola Piovesan[/b][/i], [b]ENCODYA[/b]-Chief Developer and Director of the critically-acclaimed short film '[b]Robot Will Protect You'[/b]. 

In this latest behind-the-scenes featurette, [i]“The Origins of ENCODYA”[/i], [i][b]Piovesan[/b][/i] walks viewers through the characters and setting, which were inspired by [i][b]Piovesan’s[/b][/i] short film, bringing Tina and SAM-53 along for the ride, but features a totally new story and a more fleshed-out, interactive version of Neo-Berlin. 

[i][b]Piovesan[/b][/i] describes the complex process of turning a film into a video game and provides a level of insight into the craft rarely seen, from an individual with feet firmly planted in both worlds.

[h3]Watch the full length Featurette on YouTube:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SZoZPhpxfN4

[h3]ENCODYA is now available on Windows PC, Mac, and Linux platforms via Steam and GOG as 'Standard'- and 'Save The World' Edition. [/h3]
The special “Save The World Edition” includes the artbook, soundtrack, behind-the-scenes footage, and wallpapers. 
Additionally, for every [b]Save The World Edition[/b] of ENCODYA sold, [b]10% of the proceeds[/b] will be [b]donated to Plan International[/b], a charity committed to advancing children's rights and equality for young girls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/fb7aba80d2588a026a65ac18ccbdbab8cabc8c64.gif[/img]


[h3]Key Features of ENCODYA:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]A Touching Story of Survival:[/b] The world of Neo-Berlin is a scary, aggressive place, but Tina and SAM-53 find strength in their bond that will help see them through to better times
[*] [b]A Glimpse Into our Potential Future:[/b] The corporate dystopian hell of 2062 with its eerily prescient billboards and familiar ad jingles offers a reflection — and a warning — about our contemporary world and where we might be headed, thanks to a brilliantly realized world designed by Nicola Piovesan.
[*] [b]Come Back Again Soon:[/b] There is plenty to explore in Neo-Berlin, and to keep players visiting again and again, ENCODYA’s puzzles are randomly generated, so each new playthrough provides a unique challenge!
[*] [b]Old Fashioned Hand-Crafted Design:[/b] Like your favorite Indie band or craft beer, ENCODYA was a passion-project designed by a hands-on developer with a very specific vision.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6787498da326c8484042133ddea429397402c69c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Cyberpunk Adventure ENCODYA is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Join Spunky Orphan Tina and Her Armored Automaton Bestie as They Set Out to Bring Their City Back from the Brink[/b][/i]

Together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i] we are pleased to announce that our [i]Bladerunner-meets-Full Throttle point-and-click adventure game[/i], [b]ENCODYA[/b], is now available on Steam for Windows, MacOS and Linux. 
Not only that, but in classic Assemble Entertainment fashion, a special [b]“Save the World” edition[/b] is also available, which comes with the [i][b]official artbook, soundtrack, several “making-of” videos, and gorgeous high definition wallpapers.[/b][/i] 
In keeping with the game’s theme, [b]for every “Save the World” edition sold, we will donate 10% of the proceeds to the children’s charity Plan International, an organization that works to advance children’s rights and equality for girls worldwide.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6787498da326c8484042133ddea429397402c69c.gif[/img]

[b]ENCODYA[/b] follows in the footsteps of beloved titles like [i]Monkey Island[/i] and [i]Day of the Tentacle[/i], but with a hefty dose of dystopian cyberpunk stylings. Join the plucky ragamuffin Tina and her best pal, an imposing mass of metal and wiring named SAM-53, as they navigate the gritty streets of Neo-Berlin. Tina and SAM-53 must use their wits to help fix a society where mankind has become hopelessly addicted to the technology that allows them to ignore the plight of their city and waste their days in a virtual world.

[h3]Watch the Encodya release trailer here: [/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uznsnKsM83Q


[h3]About ENCODYA[/h3]
[i]“It’s been a long journey with plenty of blood, sweat, and tears to get Encodya into the hands of players,”[/i] said Nicola Piovesan, Founder of Chaosmonger Studio. [i]“We here at Chaosmonger poured our hearts and souls into this project and can’t wait to see people join Tina and SAM-53 on their quest to save Neo Berlin.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/e113d98588dfac0bd7bfec5d8d855f1b350ab2db.gif[/img]

Encodya has been painstakingly and lovingly crafted from the ground up, including a [b]completely original soundtrack[/b] — right down to the ad jingles found across Neo Berlin — along with [b]35 unique and distinctive NPCs and a whopping 4,000+ lines of dialogue[/b]. 
A cute and colorful art design with a hint of something more sinister reflects the progress, or lack thereof, of a city under siege from rampant capitalism and an overreliance on technology. 
Explore a beautifully realized world, solve puzzles, and help Tina and SAM-53 bring life and love back into the city they call home.

[h3]Key Features of ENCODYA Include: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Bring Your Michelin Guide:[/b] Neo Berlin is a big city with a lot to see, and players can explore more than 100 unique locations
[*] [b]Thank You, Please Visit Us Again:[/b] Enjoyed your time exploring the city and want to make a return trip? Encodya features randomly generated puzzle solutions to add more value to multiple playthroughs
[*] [b]Get Chatty with a Cast of Crazy Characters:[/b] During their journey, Tina and SAM-53 will meet all sorts of interesting people (and robots), and with 4,000 lines of dialogue to experience, they’ll be spending plenty of time getting to know them
[*] [b]Keep Your Eyes Peeled:[/b] In keeping with the games by which it was inspired, Encodya is packed to the brim with tiny details, easter eggs, and a fully-fleshed out world to explore[/list]


[b]Keep up to date with ENCODYA by following the game on [url=https://twitter.com/encodya]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/robotwillprotectyou]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/robotwillprotectyou/]Instagram[/url]. 
Join the Assemble Entertainment community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/assemble-entertainment]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/AssembleEntertainment/]reddit[/url] for even more news![/b]


[h3]ENCODYA is now available on Windows PC, Mac, and Linux platforms via Steam and GOG![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/ENCODYA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/f962da986848a9276d5019330454e0cd1ba36b7d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New ENCODYA featurette takes players behind the scenes of ENCODYA
notes.notes:
Together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i] we are inviting you behind the scenes of the upcoming cyberpunk adventure game [b]ENCODYA[/b], with [i][b]Chief Developer Nicola Piovesan[/b][/i]. 

Coming to [b]Steam[/b] on [b]January 26, 2021[/b], [b]ENCODYA[/b] brings players to the dystopian near-future of Neo-Berlin, where a young orphan girl named Tina teams up with a hulking mass of metal and wiring named SAM-53 to bring light and happiness back to the hellish cyberpunk landscape of 2062.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/e113d98588dfac0bd7bfec5d8d855f1b350ab2db.gif[/img]

In this new featurette, [i][b]Piovesan[/b][/i] takes players behind the scenes and dives into the little details that truly bring the world of Neo-Berlin to life. An adventure game succeeds, when it offers a believable fantasy world for players to explore and discover, and as [i][b]Piovesan[/b][/i] explains in the video, ensuring each element of the game lends itself to the experience is key to doing so. From the creation of completely original billboards and advertising jingles to simple things like the dialogue between NPCs on the street, Piovesan takes viewers through the creation process, providing developer insight into how creating an authentic world is possible with a strong narrative and plenty of subtle background detail.
 
[h3]Watch the new full length ENCODYA featurette on YouTube:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5JuLqGHVRSM


[h3]Additional Key Features of Encodya Include: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Entirely Original Soundtrack and Audio:[/b] Not only will players enjoy a unique, custom soundtrack, but everything from the character dialogue to the advertising jingles are self-produced audio tracks, not simply sound bites from an audio-library
[*] [b]A Robust Script:[/b] To really bring the world of Encodya to life, more than 4,000 lines of dialogue provide an engaging and immersive cinematic experience
[*] [b]This Puzzle Was Different Last Time...:[/b] Puzzle randomization adds replay value and a fresh challenge for players looking to enjoy multiple trips to Neo-Berlin 
[*] [b]A Full Cast of Characters:[/b] With 34 distinct NPCs, the dystopian world of Neo-Berlin is brought to life with a whole host of fully-realized individuals
[/list]

[h3]ENCODYA will be available on Windows PC, MacOS, and Linux platforms via Steam on January 26, 2021.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/e5f79f993261d6b195c42041f8eb9ba4e090bc8f.jpg[/img]

Together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i] we are delighted to share today a [b]new trailer[/b] and an [b]official release date[/b] for the upcoming dystopian point-and-click adventure game [b]ENCODYA[/b]. 

[b]On January 26, 2021, ENCODYA will make its debut on Windows PC, Mac, and Linux[/b] here on Steam. 
Following a nine-year-old orphan and her clumsy robot guardian and set in the year 2062, [i][b]ENCODYA[/b][/i] is a dark yet heartwarming tale of love, perseverance, and greed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/fb7aba80d2588a026a65ac18ccbdbab8cabc8c64.gif[/img]

[i][b]ENCODYA[/b][/i] puts you in the role of [i]Tina[/i], an orphan with nothing to call her own. Her guardian, a large and lumbering robot named [i]SAM-53[/i], is her only safety and protection from a grim world full of greed and brutal poverty. Controlled by tyrannical corporations, [i]Tina[/i] and [i]SAM-53[/i] must make the best of their circumstances in order to set out on an adventure to turn their cyberpunk dystopia into a lively utopia once more. Without knowing what danger lurks behind the next corner, [i]Tina[/i] will rely on her wit and [i]SAM-53[/i]’s metal muscle to leave a life of homelessness and scavenging behind her. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6787498da326c8484042133ddea429397402c69c.gif[/img]

[h3]Watch the new ENCODYA gameplay trailer here: [/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P7CbC1ABjLM


[h3]About ENCODYA[/h3]
Based on the animated short called “Robot Will Protect You,” and inspired by the atmosphere of Blade Runner and the poignant storytelling of Studio Ghibli, Encodya features a distinctive art style and deep, immersive sound design. The original soundtrack creates a thrilling atmosphere to explore the menacing world of Neo-Berlin in 2.5D with the two playable characters, Tina and SAM-53. With more than 35 NPCs to bring the story to life and over 4,000 lines of dialogue, Encodya offers a beautifully grim adventure that gracefully nods to the real-world atrocities of our current society. 

[h3]Features of ENCODYA: [/h3]
[list][*] Explore the dark cyberpunk world of ENCODYA in 2.5D with 2 playable characters.
[*] Over 34+ non-player characters bring the world and story of ENCODYA to life.
[*] More than 100 locations to discover and explore.
[*] Over 4000+ lines of dialogue tell an immersive story.
[*] Randomization of some puzzles for a unique experience.
[*] Cinematic Cut Scenes.
[*] Amazing art and sound design. 
[*] The original soundtrack creates a thrilling atmosphere.
[*] Professional dubbing actors lend their voices to the characters.
[*] Lots of Easter Eggs and 10 Secrets to find.[/list]

[h3]More about ENCODYA[/h3]

notes.title: This is ENCODYA, and this is me.
notes.notes:
The sweetness and creativity of Studio Ghibli, the setting and atmosphere of Blade Runner and the humor and game style of Monkey Island: these are the ingredients that inspired ENCODYA, a point & click adventure game set in a dystopian future.

Always swapping the two protagonists - a young girl and her big robot - to solve puzzles, ENCODYA achieves the goal of getting a genre like cyberpunk - usually dark and sad - accessible to people of all ages, also putting the humoristic element, that is not so common in the genre.

I am Nicola, the lead developer, and originally coming from the film industry. Therefore ENCODYA gets many benefits from this background: great visuals, immersive music and, most of all, a very strong story-line, to make us think about our world and what future could bring us.

The team behind it comes from all over the world: passionate talents working in remote from India to Spain, from Italy to the US, from Estonia to Australia, just to mention few countries involved. Everything is done in an "indie" way, trying to achieve a final result as close as possible to the big budget productions.

Now, it's time to get your hands on the demo and dive into the dystopian world of ENCODYA. I hope you like it as much as I do developing it.

And don't forget to wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137450/Encodya/
